description: Assign a Canvas user as a peer reviewer for one submission, and return the created peer review object (id, assessor_id, user_id, asset_id, workflow_state). The user_id parameter you pass is the reviewer being assigned; in the returned object assessor_id holds that same reviewer, while the response's own user_id field instead identifies the submission owner (the reviewee) — the two user_id values are not the same person. The new review starts in workflow_state "assigned". submission_id must already exist on this assignment. Use list_peer_reviews to see every review assigned on the whole assignment, or get_submission_peer_reviews to see only the reviews assigned to one submission, before assigning another reviewer; use delete_peer_review to unassign one. Requires instructor/TA permission in the course.

user_id.description: The Canvas user ID of the reviewer to assign
